text:
sam_supply: Zeta just flagged a 3-week slip on the H100 tranche and proposed consolidating all RMAs onto one AWB to cut brokerage fees. They say replacements might ship in two legs. Thoughts?

nina_ops: That delay knocks our eu-west reserved pool. Do we have spares that can be flown?

ali_sre: We have 6 H100 equiv in us-central warm pool. Transfer to EU + customs is ~72h realistic if courier available.

mira_fin: Quick cost check: courier air transfer ~€1.1k per 4 units. Consolidated AWB saves ~€2.8k but risks staggered arrivals which complicate credits.

zeta_bot: Zeta Logistics: We can consolidate RMAs under AWB ZETA-555222 and offer 35% expedite discount if Redwood accepts single manifest. ETA push confirmed +21 days.

sam_supply: Can vendor air 4 critical units and consolidate rest? That reduces courier spend. Zeta?

zeta_bot: Zeta Logistics: We can pre-allocate 4 expedited units at 45% discount if prepaid within 18h. Serial manifest upon payment confirmation.

nina_ops: 4 units gives ~8 days runway if we reshuffle pods. Ali will update provisioning mapping for partial replacements.

ali_sre: I'll prepare a quick remap snippet and a checklist for serial reconciliation. Pseudo: 
```
# on receive
if serial in manifest: assign_to(existing_node)
```

mira_fin: Finance can approve up to €4.5k emergency. Calculate total (vendor expedite after discount + courier).

sam_supply: Vendor expedite baseline €8k -> 45% = €4.4k + courier €600 = ~€5k. Just above. Can we ask Zeta to split expedite fee or extend hold window?

zeta_bot: Zeta Logistics: We can hold the 45% offer for 12h. Split cost discussion: we can cover 20% of courier if Redwood accepts consolidated AWB for remaining units.

mira_fin: If vendor covers 20% courier, total drops below threshold. I can sign-off. Sam, lock vendor in and get manifest by EOD.

sam_supply: Will do. Action: 1) sam_supply confirm payment terms with Zeta, 2) ali_sre draft remap + reconciliation steps, 3) nina_ops flag affected pods in capacity tracker.

ali_sre: noted. I'll also add a quick alert to monitoring to watch pod fill levels during transfer window.

sam_supply: Thanks all. Re-open if vendor changes terms. :thumbsup:
